content.short: Bitverse is a Web3 social and avatar platform that aggregates blockchain data to provide users with a unique and verifiable digital identity.
content.description: Bitverse is a data-driven Web3 social platform that allows users to create unique digital avatars backed by their on-chain activities and asset holdings. By aggregating data from across the blockchain ecosystem, Bitverse provides users with a comprehensive view of their digital footprint and reputation. It supports the Mantle Network by enabling users to track their Mantle-based assets and participate in community events through their unified Bitverse identity.
content.meta: Bitverse is a Web3 social and avatar platform for unified digital identity on Mantle. Discover Bitverse on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
